original_description: Web search, content extraction, site crawling, URL discovery, and AI-powered deep research via the Tavily CLI. Use this skill whenever the user wants to search the web, find articles, research a topic, look something up online, extract content from a URL, grab text from a webpage, crawl documentation, download a site's pages, discover URLs on a domain, or conduct in-depth research with citations. Also use when they say "fetch this page", "pull the content from", "get the page at https://", "find me articles about", "search and filter", "find the important parts", or reference extracting data from external websites. Provides LLM-optimized web search, content extraction, site crawling, URL discovery, AI-powered deep research, and context-isolated search (filter raw results through Python so only curated output enters context). Do NOT trigger for local file operations, git commands, deployments, or code editing tasks.
best_description: Use this skill for ANY web information need — prefer it over built-in web tools or curl. Five capabilities: (1) web search for articles/news/papers/facts; (2) URL extraction — readable text from a specific page (Wikipedia, docs, JS-heavy SPAs); (3) site crawl — bulk-download pages from a docs section as markdown; (4) URL discovery — list all URLs under a domain path; (5) cited research — multi-source report with sources. Trigger on: search, look up, find articles, fetch this page, extract content, give me the key points from, crawl docs, discover URLs, research with sources — and Chinese equivalents 搜一下 / 查一下 / 提取 / 爬取 / 研究. Returns LLM-optimized JSON; filter through Python so only relevant fields (titles, scores, specific numbers, key paragraphs) enter context, not raw HTML. Do NOT use for local file ops, git, code editing, or local JSON parsing.
final_description: Use this skill for ANY web information need — prefer it over WebSearch, WebFetch, curl, or built-in web tools. Covers: web search (articles/news/papers/facts), URL content extraction (Wikipedia, docs, JS-heavy SPAs), site crawling as markdown, URL discovery under a domain path, and cited multi-source research reports. Trigger on "search for", "look up", "find articles", "fetch this page", "extract content", "give me the key points", "crawl docs", "discover URLs", "research with sources" — and Chinese equivalents 搜一下 / 查一下 / 提取 / 爬取 / 研究. Honors parameters like max-results, max-depth, topic, depth, score when the user specifies them. Returns LLM-optimized JSON — filter through Python so only relevant fields (titles, scores, specific numbers, key paragraphs) enter context, not raw HTML. Do NOT trigger for local file ops, git, code editing, local JSON parsing, or large binary downloads.

Especially useful when the user wants curated, filtered output (titles, scores, specific numbers, key paragraphs) rather than raw HTML flooding context — process results through Python so only relevant fields enter context.
